ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1984
QUAID-E-AZAM UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Quaid-e-Azam University Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 5th June, 1984].
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Quaid-e-Azam University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 34, Act XXVIII of 1973

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXVII OF 1984
QUAID-E-AZAM UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Quaid-e-Azam University Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 5th June, 1984].
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information
2. Amendment of section 34, Act XXVIII of 1973.--In the Quaid-e Azam
University Act, 1973 (XXVIII of 1973), in section 34, after subsec tion (2),
the following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(3) No
order on an appeal or application for review shall be passed without affording
to the appellant or applicant, as the case may be, an opportunity of being
heard.".
